# Project Governance 4.5.2

Requested repository context keeps the supported ranked candidate set. An older directory-neighbour
lookup could append unrelated files after local or semantic selection, including a neighbour with
negative metadata advice. This patch prevents that extra lookup from widening the result.

All local and semantic route calls already supply a ranked supported set, so their automatic
directory-discovery field is now null. Same-package manifests, adjacent tests and dependency
documents need an actual local match, a resolved declared link, positive metadata advice, or an
explicit discovery/original request. Directory/package adjacency alone no longer adds them.

Local matches, resolved one-hop links, required guidance and explicit discovery/original requests
remain available. Partial extraction retains its existing coverage limits. JEV remains optional
and must be requested explicitly. Autonomous JEV non-use remains unresolved. This release
does not increase automatic provider use, change sharing permissions or spending limits, or establish
better accepted-task cost or accuracy.

Publication follows the normal 4.x local qualification and independent review path. Adoption is
deliberate; publishing this patch does not upgrade installed repositories or worktrees.
